newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gea says satisfied with business progress.
newsitem.headline: Gea says satisfied with business progress.

text.p: German process technology supplier Gea AG said on Thursday that its business progess in the first five months of this year was satisfactory.
Both orders and sales levels so far confirmed expectations for a 7.0 percent rise in internal growth this year, the firm said at its general meeting.

Gea said that its energy technology and special products departments had shown the largest rise in income orders this year, while sales had grown most in its drying technology and liquid processing departments.
The company gave no specific figures.
